messages:
samir (eng-runtime): Heads up — planning to roll runtime 2.1.3-rc -> stable in the 02:00 UTC change window tonight. Need cross-service thumbs for API, Console, Router. Quick compatibility checklist?
jia (eng-api): :eyes: API tested against 2.1.3-rc yesterday, no schema breaks. Session cookie header unchanged. Will pin API gateway to accept both `runtime-2.1.3` and `runtime-2.0.x` for 2h after cutover.
maria (eng-console): Console has a UI feature toggle that expects the newer progress events shape. We have a fallback if events are delayed, but we need runtime to keep `progress.v2` for at least 30m post-cutover. I can add a console-side feature-flagged guard.
ryan (eng-router): Router supports both protocol variants; I'll do a staged traffic shift: 5% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100% with 3m steadiness checks. If error rate > 1% in any step, we stop and rollback. Need a release note so SREs can follow the plan.
samir (eng-runtime): Sounds good. Runtime will keep `progress.v2` for 45m after final switch, then deprecate. We'll also ship a KV eviction tweak in same deploy (tiny). That KV change is low-risk but note it in notes.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: runtime-service @ sha `a1b2c3d` -> tag `2.1.3`. Canary: 1 node (us-east-1). Command: `/deploy runtime-service --tag=2.1.3 --canary=1`
jia (eng-api): Can we pin API config to prefer `2.1.3` but fallback to `2.0.x` on 503? I can add a header-based hedging rule in the router for 15m after stage complete.
ryan (eng-router): Yep, router will add hedging rule. Also will add a hard pin flag in case we need immediate failover.
oncall-ops: Oncall here. Please publish rollback criteria in the runbook: latency SLA deviations, 5xx spike threshold, user-facing errors > 0.5% over 5m. We'll monitor.
maria (eng-console): I'll update the console changelog + toast messaging for end users if we detect degraded progress events. Small banner ready.
samir (eng-runtime): Rollback plan: if canary fails -> revert canary to previous tag and abort. If staged fails -> immediate rollforward to previous stable tag and reassign traffic. I'll document exact `kubectl` steps in the runbook.
jia (eng-api): Release note draft: "Runtime 2.1.3: KV eviction tuning + progress event v2. Backwards-compatible; API gateway hedging added for 15m." Will add known impact: short-lived increased tail latency during cache warms.
oncall-ops: Add alert thresholds: p95 latency > +200ms sustained for 10m, 5xx rate > 1% sustained for 5m, user errors > 0.5% for 5m. If triggered, page `#oncall` and escalate to infra-lead.
samir (eng-runtime): Quick check: do we want a console-only hold window for 30m after canary before pushing to all regions?
maria (eng-console): Yes, prefer hold for 30m. We can flip earlier if metrics look green.
ryan (eng-router): Traffic shift plan updated: 5% -> 25% (3m) -> hold 30m console check -> 60% -> 100%. Hedging active for 15m after each stage.
deploy-bot: canary succeeded: runtime-service @ `a1b2c3d` on node `canary-01` (us-east-1). Metrics: 2xx 99.9%, p95 +30ms.
jia (eng-api): Good signal. I'll start the 25% shift now.
samir (eng-runtime): Noted. After the 25% shift completes, runtime will keep `progress.v2` for the hold window.
oncall-ops: Monitoring runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/prod/releases/1768504321 — set dashboards: runtime-p95, router-5xx-rate, api-error-rate, console-event-backlog.
maria (eng-console): Banner deployed to staging. Will enable in prod during hold.
ryan (eng-router): 25% done. Steady. No increase in 5xx.
deploy-bot: traffic-shift: runtime-service -> 25% completed.
samir (eng-runtime): moving to hold. Console: ready to validate events for 30m.
maria (eng-console): Validating now. Event backlog normal. No missing progress events.
(30m passes)
deploy-bot: hold window complete: 30m.
ryan (eng-router): Moving to 60% stage.
deploy-bot: traffic-shift: runtime-service -> 60% completed.
jia (eng-api): Observability: p95 +45ms but within alert threshold, 5xx steady. Keeping an eye.
oncall-ops: No pages. All green from monitoring.
samir (eng-runtime): Proceeding to 100%.
deploy-bot: traffic-shift: runtime-service -> 100% completed. Release tag `2.1.3` is now active.
maria (eng-console): Flipped feature flag to deprecate `progress.v2` after 45m. Posting release notes to #release-notes.
jia (eng-api): API pins removed after 1h.
samir (eng-runtime): Closing thread — thanks all. If anyone sees regressions, follow rollback doc in the runbook and ping oncall. :tada:
